title: 第23章 九级第24章 御灵使学院代表
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
一直到深夜时间，霍仙儿这才沉沉的睡了过去。
而叶凌，从躺在床上开始，就是深度睡眠状态，中途一直没有醒过。
第二天一大早，叶凌匆忙吃过早餐，给自己准备了一份午餐之后。
打了个车，又向着城外赶去。
他没有太多的时间，在这里慢慢浪费。
他需要抓紧一切时间，让自己变得更强。
第二天依旧是葬骨丘，狂刷骷髅，就算是小到骷髅兵，叶凌也一个都没有放过。
蚊子腿再小也是肉，叶凌是一点也不落下。
相比于骷髅军士，叶凌这次遇上了更加强大的骷髅士官。
骷髅士官比骷髅军士还要更强大一些。
大部分实力都在一阶七级左右，实力更加强大。
但即使是如此，却依旧没有能够阻止叶凌和血幽的升级脚步。
在系统任务的加持之下，最终叶凌和血幽成功的升级到了一阶六级，外加多出来的百分之五十多的经验值。
相比起昨天来说，今天的叶凌和血幽等级更高了，因此击败骷髅兵和骷髅军士获得的经验值，减少了一些。
之所以能够提升两级多一点，完全是因为昨天还有个任务没有完成。
百骨斩，消灭一百只骷髅，提升灵宠等级一级。
也正是因为这个任务的原因，今天叶凌和血幽直接提升到了一阶六级。
一天最少升两级，这……整个联邦里面，都没有这么有天赋的人。
不仅等级得到了提升，叶凌也获得了不少进化材料。
次级黑暗结晶，已经成功的拥有了十个以上。

现在欠缺的，就是黑暗之心以及暗黑精血了。
这两种材料都不产自葬骨丘，想要获得这两种材料需要前往黑暗类属魔物所在的地点，击败黑暗魔物才有机会获得。
但是在天辉城周围，非常遗憾的是并没有黑暗类别的魔物存在。
因此，叶凌如果想要获得黑暗之心以及暗黑精血，唯一的途径就是通过网上购买。
不过，目前叶凌当时还不是特别着急。
因为进化可不光光需要进化材料，还需要灵宠的成长度达到100%才行。
而目前，血幽的成长度也不过才17.8%。
距离达到进化的成长度，还需要花费很多的时间。
至少以目前的情况来看，进化材料完全不急。
就算是有系统的帮助，叶凌没有办法在御灵使学院考核之前进化。
既然现在还做不到，那就没有必要继续在上面浪费时间。
接下来，如此连续三天。
叶凌真正做到了，什么叫做两点一线。
content_en:
It wasn't until late at night that Huo Xianer fell into a deep sleep.
As for Ye Ling, he was in a deep sleep state from the moment he lay on the bed, and he never woke up in the middle.
Early the next morning, Ye Ling ate breakfast in a hurry and prepared a lunch for himself.
I took a taxi and headed out of the city.
He doesn't have much time to waste here.
He needs to seize every moment to make himself stronger.
The next day was still the Bone Burial Hill, with skeletons being swiped wildly. Even if it was as small as a skeleton soldier, Ye Ling would not let go of any of them.
No matter how small a mosquito's legs are, they are still meat, but Ye Ling is not inferior at all.
Compared to the Skeleton Sergeant, Ye Ling met a more powerful Skeleton Sergeant this time.
Skeleton Sergeant is more powerful than Skeleton Sergeant.
Most of the strength is around level 1 and level 7, and the strength is even stronger.
But even so, it still couldn't stop Ye Ling and Xue You from upgrading.
With the support of system tasks, Ye Ling and Xue You finally successfully upgraded to level one and level six, plus more than 50% extra experience points.
Compared with yesterday, Ye Ling and Xue You were at a higher level today, so the experience points gained from defeating skeleton soldiers and skeleton sergeants were somewhat reduced.
The reason why I was able to advance to a little more than two levels was entirely because there was a task that was not completed yesterday.
Hundred Bone Slash, destroy a hundred skeletons, and increase the level of your spiritual pet by one level.
It is precisely because of this mission that Ye Ling and Xue You were directly promoted to the first and sixth levels today.
At least two levels a day. This... there is no such talented person in the entire federation.
Not only has the level been improved, Ye Ling has also obtained a lot of evolutionary materials.
I have successfully owned more than ten secondary dark crystals.
What is lacking now is the heart of darkness and the dark essence and blood.
Neither of these two materials are produced in the Bone Burial Mound. To obtain these two materials, you need to go to the location where the dark-type monsters are located, and only by defeating the dark monsters can you have a chance to obtain them.
But around Radiant City, it is a pity that there are no dark monsters.
Therefore, if Ye Ling wants to obtain the Heart of Darkness and Dark Essence, the only way is to purchase them online.
However, Ye Ling was not particularly anxious at the moment.
Because evolution not only requires evolution materials, but also requires the spiritual pet's growth rate to reach 100%.
At present, Xueyou's growth rate is only 17.8%.
It will take a lot of time to reach the level of evolutionary growth.
At least judging from the current situation, evolutionary materials are not in a hurry at all.
Even with systematic help, Ye Ling couldn't evolve before the examination at the Imperial Spirit Envoy Academy.
Since it's not possible yet, there's no need to continue wasting time on it.
Next, this continued for three consecutive days.
Ye Ling truly achieved what is meant by two points and one line.
